Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates bilateral, smooth, lobulated paraspinal masses in the lower thoracic region without evidence of bone erosion or destruction, which is the classic radiological appearance of mediastinal extramedullary hematopoiesis. This distinguishes it from neurogenic tumors (which often cause rib/vertebral erosion) and metastatic disease.
